recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, warm-toned portrait of a male vocalist set against a deep blue radial gradient background, featuring high-contrast serif typography at the top and descriptive metadata in the lower right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm skin tones contrasting against a cool blue background
Large-scale display typography framing the subject's head
Soft, directional lighting creating depth on the facial features
Balanced asymmetry between the subject's hand and the lower-right text block
coreInvariants: Deep blue to light blue radial gradient
High-contrast serif display type with drop shadows
Warm, saturated lighting on the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered close-up portrait, head and shoulders, with the subject's hand resting on their chin.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the large white serif text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the large display text at the top, down to the subject's face, then to the descriptive text in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant blue space in the upper corners and sides to allow for typographic breathing room.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm Amber and Ochre (Skin and Shirt)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright Red (Graphic Badge) and Yellow (Script Text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background blues and skin tones; high value contrast between white text and dark background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to primary-adjacent hues (Blue, Red, Yellow)

characterSpecificRedesigns: Added drop shadows for legibility against the gradient
Tight tracking for the main display name
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the name paired with a casual script for the descriptor and a clean sans-serif for metadata.
graphicDevices: Subtle drop shadows on all text

preserve: All-caps serif for the main name
Yellow script for the top line
avoid: Modernist geometric sans-serifs for the main name

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the classic, high-contrast serif look typical of mid-century album covers.
Captures the informal, 'silky' feel of the introductory text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-quality studio portrait of a soulful male singer in a cream-colored shirt, hand to chin, looking at the camera. The background should be a smooth radial gradient from light blue in the center to deep navy at the edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist's name in large white all-caps serif font with a drop shadow across the top. Place a yellow script line above it. Add a small red circular badge and black sans-serif metadata in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the blue gradient smooth without banding?
Does the main text have a visible drop shadow for legibility?
Is the subject's skin tone warm and saturated?
Is the typography centered and balanced?

adjustableVariables: Font weight of the main display text
Color of the accent script text
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and album titles
Exact facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for typographic alignment with the subject's head
Ensure the red badge does not overlap the subject's face
Verify the gradient transition is centered behind the subject
Confirm the drop shadow is consistent across all display text
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait Subject + Radial Blue Gradient + High-Contrast Serif Header + Script Sub-header + Bottom-Right Metadata Block
